svg.aria-label: With over 6+ years of experience, I specialize in building responsive, user-focused front-end applications using modern frameworks like React and React Native. My expertise in Tailwind CSS and Material UI enables me to create clean, cohesive designs that enhance user engagement. For state management, I leverage Redux for complex applications and Zustand for lightweight solutions. On the backend, I excel in .NET Core, designing RESTful APIs, implementing microservices, and using patterns like CQRS and Mediator for maintainable and scalable systems. I also configure OAuth 2.0 for secure authentication. I have strong DevOps expertise, working with Azure (App Service, Service Bus, Azure DevOps) and AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda) to streamline development and deployment. I implement CI/CD pipelines with tools like GitHub Actions for fast, reliable deployments. Committed to localization and following industry best practices, I deliver impactful, high-quality software solutions tailored to client and user needs.
svg.title: DECRYPTED BIO
